  workflow_dispatch:

  clojars-snapshot-release:
    name: Clojars Snapshot Release

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      # Java 17 generates class file version 61.0, which is what processing has
      # been compiled with.

        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Setup Clojure
        uses: DeLaGuardo/setup-clojure@13.6.0
        with:
          cli: latest
          bb: latest

      - name: Cache Clojure dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.m2/repository
            ~/.gitlibs
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-clojure-${{ hashFiles('deps.edn') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-clojure-

      - name: System Info
        run: bb system-info

      - name: Build release jar
        run: clojure -T:build release :snapshot true

      - name: Deploy JAR
        run: clojure -T:build deploy :clojars true :snapshot true
        env:
          CLOJARS_USERNAME: ${{secrets.CLOJARS_USERNAME}}
          CLOJARS_PASSWORD: ${{secrets.CLOJARS_DEPLOY_TOKEN}}",

}
